question: For how long must the five-limb adornment be maintained during the rite?
premises: The practitioner is endowed with the five-limb ornament
The rite has a defined completion
The adornment is maintained until completion
inference: One remains adorned with the five-limb ornament until the rite is completed.
plain_english: Endowed with the five-limb ornament, one continues until the rite is completed.
